create_SVMTrainer: create an SVMTrainer instance with config, layer name, and output directory for multi-class SVM training
load_input_data: load features and targets from pickle files for SVM training with shape validation
train_SVM_models: train LinearSVC models across multiple cost values using k-fold cross validation for each class
get_best_cost_value: determine the optimal cost value per class that maximizes cross-validation average precision
test_SVM_models: test trained SVM models on test features and compute per-class average precision scores
